zoe: alert — short spike in nvme tinywrites + crc warnings on cohort us-west2-ephemeral around 11:42 UTC. GPU attach failures surfaced (~18% attach error for 4m).

henry: which pool? any iostat or kernel snippet?

zoe: pool ep-west2-c. iostat sample: ```iostat -x 1 2
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await  %util
nvme0n1 0.00 0.00 1.00 410.00 4.00 10240.00 50.00 7.80 13.2 0.2 13.0 99.3
```

lia: avgqu and util scream saturation. any janitor logs or scheduling backpressure?

zoe: janitor logs show multiple "started scrub" events queued then scheduler 429s. also kernel shows repeated nvme crc warnings on 3 hosts. storage-bot: "nvme: crc error ns=1 lba=... host=ep-host-101"

henry: mixed-firmware check? us-west2 roll last month left some hosts on old fw. mixing can increase CRCs under load.

lia: quick containment: 1) apply scrub backoff for ep-west2-c 2) cordon the 3 hosts with most CRCs 3) increase gpu attach timeout to avoid immediate fallback. agree?

zoe: applying backoff: ops-bot: `scheduler set-backoff --pool ep-west2-c --duration 900s` at 11:45 UTC. cordoned ep-host-099..101. bumping attach timeout from 30s -> 90s in autoscaler canary.

henry: good. also reduce janitor concurrency to 1 per-pool while we triage and file firmware parity ticket. lia, can you check network retransmit counts on storage control plane?

lia: on it. initial glance shows a small spike in control-plane RPC retries 11:41-11:44 — could be correlated. I'll open a control-plane follow-up.

zoe: monitoring queries: `sum(rate(nvme_io_time_seconds_total[1m])) by (cohort)` and `increase(gpu_attach_failed_total[5m])` — will update.

storage-bot: "action: set-janitor-concurrency --pool ep-west2-c --concurrency 1 executed"

henry: early results: attach error rate fell to <1% by 11:50, avgqu down to ~2. Leaving backoff 15m then gradually reintroduce scrubs with coalesce guard.

lia: follow-ups: 1) fleet firmware parity (schedule mass roll with canary), 2) scheduler hysteresis to avoid 429 pileups, 3) add noop write-combine probe to see if tinywrites are from app pattern or scrub mix.

zoe: cost note: fallback capacity during 4m window ~+$600. logging to incident-costs. will uncordon after firmware checks. closing for now, will open postmortem if it recurs. :white_check_mark:
